import pandas as pd, re, html

def norm(s):
    s = html.unescape(str(s))
    s = s.replace('\\n', ' ').replace('\\"', '"').replace("\\'", "'")
    s = s.lower()
    s = re.sub(r"([.!?,;:()\"'/\\\[\]{}*&%$#@~+=<>|`-])", r" \1 ", s)
    s = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip()
    return s

def dump(df, path):
    with open(path, 'w') as f:
        for lab, txt in zip(df['label'].values, df['text'].values):
            f.write(f"__label__{lab} {norm(txt)}\n")

tr = pd.read_parquet('/app/data/train-00000-of-00001.parquet')
tr = tr.sample(frac=1.0, random_state=0)
dump(tr, '/app/train.txt')
te = pd.read_parquet('/app/data/test-00000-of-00001.parquet')
dump(te, '/app/valid.txt')
print('done')
EOF
